summary: unexpected TOKEN, expected one of: LIST
rationale: Each token must fit the current production.
Unsupported statements must not create model nodes.
An open construct needs its closing delimiter.
One symbol must have one consistent declaration.

summary: invalid metadata KEY for KIND ID
rationale: Metadata properties must apply to the target kind.
Assignments and notes require a target of the correct kind.
Actor geometry options must be compatible.

summary: rectangular use case ID cannot be business
rationale: Business use cases require ellipse geometry.
Relationship kinds constrain endpoint and marker kinds.

summary: endpoint ID uses classes without a declaration
rationale: An endpoint class suffix requires a node declaration.
A JSON node must contain a strict JSON object.
